canonical_title: VitriApp-Aufträge - Mobile application for checklists in a computer-aided facility management context
abstract: Checklists are everywhere, they help us to reduce failure by compensating for potential limits of human memory and attention. Especially when it comes to facility management, checklists are a good tool for the people who feed the system with data such that every time there is a routine to be followed, the person can just use a checklist to not forget anything. Similar to when we go grocery shopping and do not prepare a list, often we buy unnecessary things, and worse we forgot things that we urgently need. This is the reason EBCsoft GmbH is developing Vormula Editor, Vormula App and VitriApp-Aufträge. With the Vormula Editor, the customer can create custom checklists with endless possibilities. To use these checklists, the customer has two choices: Vormula App, a simple mobile application where the user can download checklists from the Vormula Editor, fill them out, and export them via email. Second, the VitriApp-Aufträge, which also has all the features of the Vormula-App but can connect with the Vitricon CAFM. Both of these applications are already in production and available for Android, iOS, and UWP. After an initial proof of concept prototype at the beginning of 2020, I began working on developing both applications in April 2021. Even though both applications are already in use by our customers, the applications are still in active development, as customers require more and more features. Because of this, it was and still is very important to keep the code quality at high standards such that new features and changes can be implemented quickly. This is reached by using design patterns and principles like Clean Code, Clean Architecture, and SOLID principles.
